{{Quote|Fire up the ship. Let's go find an honest crime to commit.|Cade Bane to Ttekket|<ref name="Bane vs ...Bane?" />}}
This '''[[Personal Luxury Yacht 3000/Legends|Personal Luxury Yacht 3000]]''' was purchased by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], disguised as [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]], from a [[Unidentified Bith starship dealer|Bith starship dealer]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] was purchased as part of an undercover mission to uncover a [[Plan to kidnap Chancellor Palpatine/Legends|kidnapping plot]] spearheaded by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]].
